basic_details.job_title: DHS Sivagangai Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for DPPM Coordinator and Driver Posts
basic_details.post_name: District Public-Private Mix Coordinator (DPPM) and Driver

qualification.details: District Public-Private Mix Coordinator (DPPM): Post Graduate degree. One year of experience working in the field of Communication / ACSM / Private / Public Partnership / Health Projects / Programme. Basic knowledge of computers. Permanent Two-wheeler driving license and ability to drive a two-wheeler. Preference to those who have worked in NTEP. Certificate / Diploma / Degree / Masters holders in Social Sciences / Mass Media / Communication / Rural Development Advocacy / Partnerships / related fields. DRIVER: High School Certificate. Permanent driving license for heavy vehicles. Knowledge of minor/routine vehicle repairs.

salary_details.details: District Public-Private Mix Coordinator (DPPM): 29000 per month DRIVER: 17500 per month

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DHS Sivagangai Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: sivaganga.nic.in/.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 11-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DHS Sivagangai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the DHS Sivagangai Recruitment 2026 is 11 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the DHS Sivagangai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the posts of DISTRICT PUBLIC PRIVATE MIX CO-ORDINATOR (DPPM) and Driver.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the DPPM post?
faq.answer: For the DPPM post, candidates need to have a Post Graduate degree and relevant experience in communication or health projects.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Driver post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Driver post is 17500 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The age limit details are not specified in the provided data and candidates should refer to the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents need to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents like photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of DHS Sivagangai, as indicated in the "How to Apply" section.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is contractual.
